Panorama Stitching Playground

Three approaches to stitch 2 overlapping images side by side:

1. SUBGRAPH: manual pipeline (ORB → BFMatcher → RANSAC → StitchCanvas → ConstantLike masks → 4×warpPerspective BORDER_CONSTANT → FeatherBlend).

2. STITCH (AUTO): cv2.Stitcher.create() - one-click, black-box stitching.

3. STITCH (ADVANCED): cv2.detail pipeline with full control over features, matching, warps, exposure compensation, seam finding, and blending.

Images: panorama_A.png and panorama_B.png (place overlapping photos in ComfyUI/input).
